comments.text: Just nak bagi comment siket. Based on observation sebenarnya yang kebanyakkan suruh sambung belajar ni adalah dari kalangan baby boomers and early stage of gen y yg dapat merasa degree dizaman tu sangatlah bernilai. But as of now degree takde apa2 tapi just a vague ticket and for me memang overrated sebab bila kita tengok open position for degree holder and professionals sebenarnya makin lama makin siket. Yang banyak position dibuka adalah all low to mid skill level sahaja. Untuk pendapat aq pada calon lepasan spm boleh lah terus masuk ke alam perkerjaan dengan masuk ke apprenticeship program. Banyak dah company2 besar and MNC buat apprenticeship untuk fresh spm ni and best part is benda tu free je. Free knowledge, free money from allowance, dapat pulak working experience and tak lupa jugak dapat secured permanent job dalam satu masa and satu package. If dapat pulak apprenticeship under MNC macam dah boleh kerja situ sampai pencen. Namun jangan pulak rasa selesa selepas apprenticeship yang gaji tu dah lagi tinggi dari most normal fresh graduates tapi kena terus jugak belajar secara part time such as boleh perlahan2 lah kayuh ambil part time dari diploma, degree, master dan seterusnya. Belajar diploma and degree secara part time ni bukan benda yang mudah, ramai jugak yang kecundang di tengah jalan tapi if you hold a little bit longer and dapat habiskan, yoi will the different. Memang jalan dia lambat dan berliku2 tapi its a slow, steady, safe and secure road to take. Dalam masa yang sama selepas je habis apprenticeship tu, means you dah pon ada work experience dalam company tu dan berkemungkinan besar company dah percaya dengan capability you at that time and boleh hantar untuk buat professional certificate and external training which also more opportunities to learn dan berkemungkinan certificate yang diambil under company tu jauh lebih bernilai dari degree yang sedia ada tu. Just imagine in 10 years you masuk apprenticeship selepas habis sambung pulak part time diploma and degree, also at the same time dapat jugak professional certificate under company and in the end you ada 10 years of working experience. Silap2 dah boleh lompat company and demand 5 angka dah time ni. Akhir kata, route yang saya tulis ni sounds easy tapi perlu kekuatan mental dan fizikal yang kuat. Ramai yang kecundang atas faktor masing2 dan yang succeedost of them tu memang dah sky rocket perginya interms of career growth. Apa saja pilihan takde salah and takde yang betul but always have their own consequences but the question is how far that you could coop and handle the consequences. If you want to pursue in the apprenticeship program please do you own research for the company that you will be work on, in terms of company profile, culture, growth, career growth and other.

comments.text:
If you give poor people a choice of :-
1) 3 years degree with starting salary of 1.8k + loan + taxes
2) Grab Driver/Rider 3k + longer works hours 

99% people choose will grab driver. Why? 
1) Poor people want money NOW not later, I want rice on the table NOW not 10 years from now. 

Itulah "Porverty Trap". 

Problemnya orang yang comment di sini mostly well off, mereka ada basic utilities based on Marslow Hierarchy of Needs. 

Mostly poor people tak sempat nak tengok video ni sebab mereka tiada stable income. Every second counts. In terms of Financial Literracy memang TERUK. Kalau dia dapat 5000 ringgit sebulan, mereka akan guna semuanya without any savings. Science Stream background paling teruk when comes to financial literacy. I ask them why choose Science Stream, 90% said "Saya masuk sebab nak buat my parents proud" or "Science Stream Banyak Peluang kerja" which is the biggest LIE on 2020 era. 10% said they already know what is their endgame. 

Let's talk about university, I observe how poor people participate dalam groups, some of them are good and some of them are bad but to them because there is an "invisible barrier" know as "The CLASS System". They tend to isolate diri sendiri sebab to their Pov, "siapa nak aku, aku nobody bukan anak orang kaya". Saya pernah ambil budak2 yang susah to be in a group of M40 and T20 through process "integration" and what I found that poor people tends to give more excuses when comes to commitment. IT GET TOUGH bila we want to teach him/her, they tend to be more ego compare the middle and rich class. Bila present 0 knowledge. Then, this "people" steal credit by giving 0 efforts.

REMEMBER, University was built by the rich to maintain the rich through connections.

Pesanan untuk adik-adik lepasan SPM.

1. Jgn fikir sgt kos tu ade demand ke tak. Kalau dah minat apa salahnya persue. 
2. Survey career pathway. Amek tau cabang sesuatu bidang. Amek tau apa skill yang diperlukan dalam industry tersebut. 
3. Masa 4 tahun study ini lah masa kita penuhkan resume. Jgn cakap fresh grad xde skill okay. Dalam kelas kita belajar theory, balik rumah kene ada inisiatif sendiri nak develop real skill. Kalau awak perform, boleh buat 'Capstone Project' sendiri. Komfem employer panggil.
4. Intern dan FYP align ngan bidang yang kita nak masuk.
5. Lepasan degree ramai dan kompetitif. Sebabtu kita kene stand out. Pointer cantik big plus, gaji pon ade plus tau.

InshaAllah follow step ni resume korang mantap. HR pon segan nak turndown application korang.
